Hi! I'm Frederic, an Associate Actuary at [SCOR](https://www.scor.com) based in
Atlanta, Georgia. I work on biometric risks: I help quantify mortality,
longevity and policyholder behavior risks for life insurance and reinsurance.
My day-to-day work combines advanced statistical modeling with data and
actuarial judgment to support product development, pricing and portfolio
management.

I took a non-linear path into actuarial science. I started out in statistics,
then spent six years as Biostatistician at the Ministry of Health in
Benin. There I designed research studies and used survival, regression and mixed
models to extract evidences to inform policies on health system. That experience taught me to
think hard about how data is generated before trusting what it says, and I
still bring that mindset to every model I build.

Today I build solutions with R, Python and AI tools, and I keep learning about
machine learning, deep learning and generative AI. This site is where I share
what I learn, through tutorials, notes and experiments, so that peers can
learn it a little faster.

## Interests

- **Biometric risk modeling**: mortality, longevity and policyholder behavior risks assessment and management
- **Predictive modeling & machine learning**: regularization, ensembles, deep learning.
- **Generative AI**: building LLM-powered tools and workflows to integrate AI into actuarial expertise.
- **Biostatistics**: interested in methods that can be transferred from biostatistics to use for solving  actuarial science problems.
- **Teaching**: Love to share knowledge and mentor others in actuarial science, data science and machine learning.

## Education

**MS, Actuarial Science** · University of Iowa · 2018 – 2020

**MPH, Public Health Methodology** · Université libre de Bruxelles · 2014 – 2015

**BS, Mathematics & Statistics** · Université d'Abomey-Calavi

**Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA)** · Society of Actuaries
